title: The induced cochain tensor and unit maps are the fixed normalized comparisons
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, assume HasDerivedCategory for every section-module category, and let T be a scheme. Give the ordinary section equivalence E=(equivalence Λ T).functor any strong monoidal structure whose oplax maps are the fixed ordinary comparisons: δ_E(M,N)=(ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M N).hom and η_E=(ordinaryUnitComparison Λ T).hom. For the induced strong monoidal structure on E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ), its oplax binary maps equal (cochainTensorComparison Λ T A B).hom for every pair of internal cochain complexes A,B, and its oplax unit equals (totalUnitComparison Λ T).hom. These are the native sum-total tensors on unbounded complexes, with no flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: Componentwise equality δ_E=ordinaryTensorComparison identifies the ordinary oplax tensor natural transformation with sectionOrdinaryTensorMap. Apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison to this equality. The cochain monoidal construction uses precisely this totalized transformation as its oplax tensorator. sectionTotalComparison_eq identifies its result with the specified cochainTensorComparison.

proof.text: The explicit source-library mapCochainComplex_η formula gives the cochain oplax unit as the inverse of mapCochainComplexεIso. Expand its two isomorphism factors: it is the canonical single-map comparison followed by the single-complex functor applied to η_E. Substitute the normalized ordinary unit hypothesis. The resulting composite is exactly the hom of totalUnitComparison.

theorem section_cochain_monoidal_constraints (T : Scheme.{u})
    [(equivalence Λ T).functor.Monoidal]
    (hd : ∀ M N : internalModules Λ T,
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (equivalence Λ T).functor M N =
        (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M N).hom)
    (hη : Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (equivalence Λ T).functor =
      (ordinaryUnitComparison Λ T).hom) :
    (∀ A B : CochainComplex (internalModules Λ T) ℤ,
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
        ((equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) A B =
          (cochainTensorComparison Λ T A B).hom) ∧
    (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η
      ((equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) =
        (totalUnitComparison Λ T).hom)
